question: The back pitch of an armature winding affects:

options.text: the distribution of the armature winding
the number of coils per pole

solution:
The correct answer is __the distribution of the armature winding****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The back pitch__ is a key parameter in armature winding design.
 
• It directly impacts the distribution of the armature winding and determines how the coils are arranged across the slots.
 
• Proper selection of back pitch ensures balanced EMF generation and reduces harmonics.
 
• It also affects the performance and efficiency of the electrical machine.
 
• Incorrect back pitch can lead to unequal magnetic fields and commutation issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Armature Winding:**
 
 
• It is the winding in which the working EMF is induced by the relative motion of the magnetic field and the conductor.
 
• There are two types of armature windings: lap winding and wave winding.
 
 
 
• **Commutator:**
 
 
• The commutator is a mechanical rectifier that converts the alternating current induced in the armature winding into direct current.
 
• It segments the armature winding for proper current collection.
 
 
 
• **Harmonics in Armature Winding:**
 
 
• Harmonics can be reduced by proper winding distribution and using a specific winding pitch.
 
• Minimizing harmonics improves machine performance and reduces losses.
